description: Hour-grid schedule for a single day, using hour-view and calendar-event children

attributes.name: data-date
attributes.description: ISO date for this day view (e.g., 2026-04-10). Names the hour list (aria-label) and is passed as detail.date in day-view:event-click.

attributes.name: data-start-hour
attributes.description: First hour (0-23) of the grid the component generates when there is no authored <ol>, or 'auto' for a sparse range (first event hour - 1 to last event hour + 1). The range grows to fit events outside it. Ignored when you author the <ol>.

attributes.name: data-end-hour
attributes.description: Last hour (0-23) of the generated grid. Ignored when data-start-hour is 'auto' or the <ol> is authored.

attributes.name: data-compact
attributes.description: Compact presentation for dialog or overlay embedding

attributes.name: data-label-continues
attributes.description: Text appended to the accessible name of a spanning event that runs past the last visible hour (localisation hook).

events.name: day-view:event-click
events.description: Fired when a calendar-event is clicked, or activated with Enter/Space while focused
events.detail: { date, time, text, element, category, duration }

events.name: day-view:events-changed
events.description: Fired after the events property rebuilds the view

properties.name: events
properties.type: Array<{ time?, text, category?, duration?, href? }>
properties.description: Get the day's events as data, or assign an array to rebuild the view (sets data-start-hour="auto"). time is HH:MM or a full ISO datetime (wall-clock as written); omit it for an all-day event. Durations (data-duration): 2h, 1.5h, 45m, 90m, 1h30m, bare minutes (60), ISO-8601 (PT1H30M); unparseable values fall back to 1 hour.

methods.name: refresh()
methods.description: Re-measure and re-position spanning events now (they also re-position automatically when the view resizes)

childAttributes.name: data-duration
childAttributes.description: Makes the event span hour rows. Durations (data-duration): 2h, 1.5h, 45m, 90m, 1h30m, bare minutes (60), ISO-8601 (PT1H30M); unparseable values fall back to 1 hour. Overlapping spans are laid out side by side.

childAttributes.name: data-start
childAttributes.description: Minute offset within the hour row; set automatically in generated grids for :30+ start times.

childAttributes.name: data-continues
childAttributes.description: Set by the component (not authored) on a spanning event clipped at the last visible hour; styled with a dashed end edge.

structure.description: Single hour slot containing time label + hour-view
Container for calendar-event elements within the hour
Individual event with time, category, and optional duration
